steps.title: Initialize Project Structure
steps.description: Set up fundamental Android SDK configurations with Java 8 compatibility and SDK target 34.

steps.title: Register Application Manifest
steps.description: Configure App Manifest containing pure Android system theme, permission definitions, and registration of main activity.

steps.title: Create App Metadata Configuration
steps.description: Write app metadata description tracking package identification structures.

steps.title: Define UI Color Configuration
steps.description: Define standard palette configurations for the tracker system dashboard layout UI elements.

steps.title: Implement Card Elements Styling
steps.description: Create custom shaped drawables for standard, positive (Income), and negative (Expense) layout card items.

steps.title: Establish Database Management Schema
steps.description: Program the SQLite storage engine helper layer for transactional management of income and expense allocations.

steps.title: Implement Data Models
steps.description: Create standard Java models representing discrete Transactions and aggregated Monthly Category breakdown statistics.

steps.title: Construct Main Dashboard Layout
steps.description: Generate activity layout featuring dual views (Tracker & Reports) mapped under functional tab management components.

steps.title: Design Layout Rows for List Presentation
steps.description: Build layout templates for single transaction item details and aggregated category status meters.

steps.title: Design New Transaction Dialog UI
steps.description: Construct dialog form permitting customization of values including categories, payment amount, transactional note, and calendar selectors.

steps.title: Develop List Adapter Frameworks
steps.description: Program adapter components for real-time binding of SQLite operations into active system lists.

steps.title: Implement Main Controller Functionality
steps.description: Integrate database hooks, dialog orchestration, transaction queries, report engines, and tab layouts in MainActivity.

steps.title: Building Expense Tracker Pro
steps.description: Compile, assemble and finalise the application under targeted build requirements.
